name: Jump rope
lead: A jump rope (skipping rope) is a cord with handles that is swung under the feet and over the head while the user jumps. Ropes range from basic PVC speed ropes to weighted ropes and beaded ropes.
It is used for cardiovascular conditioning, footwork and calf endurance, and it is cheap and portable. For appearance goals it is mostly a way to raise energy expenditure and stay lean.

paras: Repeated low jumps load the calves, feet and heart with a rhythmic, plyometric demand, raising heart rate quickly. A 2022 systematic review of 21 trials in healthy young people found small to moderate gains in cardiorespiratory endurance, jumping, strength and body fat, but no effect on bone, lean mass or blood pressure.

Calf, shin and Achilles overuse injuries are common in beginners who do too much too soon, and landing on hard surfaces stresses joints. Trial populations were young and healthy. The claim of big calf development is overstated: jumping builds calf endurance more than size.

studies.title: Jump rope training effects on health- and sport-related physical fitness in young participants: a systematic review with meta-analysis
